races.title: State Senate, District 37
races.note: The top two finishers from the Nov 3, 2026 count. Everyone else in this race is coming.

cands.name: Vickie Sawyer
cands.bio: Republican state senator for North Carolina Senate District 37 (Iredell County, Cornelius, northern Huntersville), in the Senate since 2018. Chairs the Senate Transportation Committee. Co-owner since 2002 of Sawyer Insurance & Financial Services in Mooresville. UNC Charlotte graduate in special education.
cands.gaps: We found no bills she sponsored, official actions, or stated positions that clearly bear on data centers, homestead property taxes, land ownership by investors or foreigners, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, policing, guns, abortion, or school choice. Her campaign site speaks only in general terms about conservative principles, transportation, raising the age of child marriage, and high school athletics fees. Her birthplace and the year she moved to her current home are not documented in the pages we could read. We found no notable endorsements for the 2026 race. She did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey, so we have no questionnaire answers from her. The scorecards Ballotpedia lists carry no scores for her in the pages we read.

local.label: Roots 90: Her campaign biography says she grew up in rural Davidson County and graduated from Parkland High School in Winston-Salem, and she has lived in Mooresville since at least 2002, but her birthplace is not stated.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: State senator since 2018, serving on the Finance, Appropriations/Base Budget, and Commerce and Insurance committees. Co-owner of Sawyer Insurance & Financial Services in Mooresville since 2002, a licensed insurance agent, and a former Iredell County Planning Board member.
qual.why: About eight years of prior legislative service, including work on finance and budget-related committees, plus a business-owner career. Committee chairmanships and civic or nonprofit board seats were not counted toward the score.

cands.name: Raygan J. Angel
cands.bio: Raygan Angel is a law student and Democratic organizer from North Carolina. He sits on the NC Democratic Party State Executive Committee. He won the March 2026 Democratic primary for State Senate District 37 and has held no elected office.

endorsements.text: Ballotpedia lists voter-guide recommendations from a number of Sway voting groups, including NC Public School Champions, Fair Map Fight Club and YALLvote. These are informal online voter guides, not organizations or officials.

cands.gaps: We could not find his birthplace or when he may have moved within North Carolina. We found no employer, job history or dated work record beyond being a law student and party organizer. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey, and his campaign pages give only general themes (public schools, healthcare, wages, water and land, fair maps). We found no specific plans on data centers, homestead property taxes, land ownership by investors or foreign buyers, immigration, policing, guns, abortion, or school choice. We also found no documented land-use stances, controversies, or foreign ties.

local.label: Roots 90: His campaign site says he grew up in North Carolina and describes him as a community leader rooted in the Carolinas, but no birthplace is given.

score.why: Raised $0, under $5,000 for this office: too little money to score fairly.

qual.background: Law student and organizer focused on turnout and voter engagement, and a member of the NC Democratic Party State Executive Committee. The campaign site says he works while in law school but names no employer or job.
qual.why: He has no prior elected office and no documented legal, policy or budget career. The party committee seat does not count toward the score, which leaves a student with an organizing background.
